comment: Start, end, layer change and filament change G-code per printer family, and the models that use them, for printers the extraction that writes gcode.json has no preset for: families written for SlicerX by hand, and maker_* families holding the maker's own text from a release that extraction does not read (maker_bambu_h3c, the Bambu Lab H3C's G-code from the maker's 02.09.01.70 stock presets). It has the shape of gcode.json and is merged with it when the profiles load; a family or model in both files is refused. Edit this file, not gcode.json.

sovol_sv04.start:
; Sovol SV04 in its default auto-park mode: on a tool change the firmware parks the idle carriage at its end of X
G90 ; absolute moves
M83 ; relative extrusion
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 T0 S150 ; keep the nozzles from oozing while homing
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M104 T1 S150
{endif}G28 ; home, both carriages go to their ends
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]} ; heat both nozzles together
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M104 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}
{endif}M109 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]}
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M109 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}
T1 ; prime the right tool along the right edge
G1 Z5 F600
G1 X298 Y10 F3000
G1 Z0.28 F240
G92 E0
G1 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime line
G1 X297.6 F5000
G92 E0
G1 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime line back
G92 E0
G1 Z5 F600
{endif}T0 ; prime the left tool along the left edge
G1 Z5 F600
G1 X2 Y10 F3000
G1 Z0.28 F240
G92 E0
G1 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime line
G1 X2.4 F5000
G92 E0
G1 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime line back
G92 E0
G1 Z2 F600
T[initial_tool] ; the first tool of the print comes out, the other stays parked
sovol_sv04.end:
G1 Z{min(max_layer_z + 2, printable_height)} F600 ; lift off the print
M104 T0 S0
M104 T1 S0
M140 S0
M107
G1 Y{print_bed_max[1] * 0.8} F{travel_speed * 60} ; present the print
G1 Z{min(max_layer_z + 70, printable_height - 10)} F600
M84 X Y E
sovol_sv04.changeFilament:
; The firmware parks the old carriage and brings out the new one on its next move
T[next_extruder]
M109 T[next_extruder] S{if layer_num < 1}{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[next_extruder]}{else}{nozzle_temperature[next_extruder]}{endif} ; wait for the new tool's temperature

prusa_core_one_indx.start:
; Prusa Core One with INDX: the Core One's own start G-code with the INDX changes SlicerX needs, each marked INDX
; (estimated until Prusa publishes its INDX profile; not yet run on a real printer)

; --- Printer Initialization and Checks ---

M17 ; enable steppers
M862.1 P{nozzle_diameter[initial_tool]} A{(printer_notes=~/.*ABRASIVE_NOZZLE.*/ ? 1 : 0)} F{(printer_notes=~/.*HF_NOZZLE.*/ ? 1 : 0)} ; nozzle check
M862.3 P "COREONE" ; printer model check
M862.5 P2 ; g-code level check
M862.6 P"Input shaper" ; FW feature check
M115 U6.3.0+10073

; --- Print Area and Coordinate System ---

M555 X{(min(print_bed_max[0], first_layer_print_min[0] + 32) - 32)} Y{(max(0, first_layer_print_min[1]) - 4)} W{((min(print_bed_max[0], max(first_layer_print_min[0] + 32, first_layer_print_max[0])))) - ((min(print_bed_max[0], first_layer_print_min[0] + 32) - 32))} H{((first_layer_print_max[1])) - ((max(0, first_layer_print_min[1]) - 4))} ; define print area

G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder in relative mode

; --- Preparation ---

{if chamber_temperature[initial_tool] > 35} 
; we need to preheat the chamber
M140 S115 ; set bed temp for chamber heating
{else} 
; just set the selected bed temp otherwise
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
{endif}

G28 ; home all axes without mesh bed leveling
T[initial_tool] ; INDX: pick up the first tool
M109 R{((filament_notes[initial_tool]=~/.*HT_MBL10.*/) ? (first_layer_temperature[initial_tool] - 10) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "PC" or filament_type[initial_tool] == "PA") ? (first_layer_temperature[initial_tool] - 25) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "FLEX") ? 210 : 170)} ; wait for temp

M84 E ; turn off E motor


; -- Chamber Temperature Control --
{if chamber_temperature[initial_tool] > 35} ; if we need to heat the chamber
; min chamber temp section
M104 T{initial_tool} S{if idle_temperature[initial_tool] == 0}100{else}{idle_temperature[initial_tool]}{endif} ; set idle temp
G1 Z10 F720 ; set bed position
G1 X242 Y10 F4800 ; set print head position (INDX: on the bed, clear of the docks)
M191 S{chamber_temperature[initial_tool]} ; wait for minimal chamber temp
M141 S0 ; set nominal chamber temp
M107
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp

{else}
M141 S{if chamber_temperature[initial_tool] == 0}20{else}{chamber_temperature[initial_tool]}{endif} ; set nominal chamber temp
{endif}

{if first_layer_bed_temperature[initial_tool]<=60}M106 S70{endif}
G0 Z40 F10000
M104 T{initial_tool} S{if idle_temperature[initial_tool] == 0}100{else}{idle_temperature[initial_tool]}{endif}
M190 R[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
M107

G29 G ; absorb heat

M109 R{((filament_notes[initial_tool]=~/.*HT_MBL10.*/) ? (first_layer_temperature[initial_tool] - 10) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "PC" or filament_type[initial_tool] == "PA") ? (first_layer_temperature[initial_tool] - 25) : (filament_type[initial_tool] == "FLEX") ? 210 : 170)} ; wait for MBL temp

M302 S160 ; lower cold extrusion limit to 160C

{if filament_type[initial_tool]=="FLEX"}
G1 E-4 F2400 ; retraction
{else}
G1 E-2 F2400 ; retraction
{endif}

M84 E ; turn off E motor

; --- Mesh Bed Leveling (MBL) ---

G29 P9 X208 Y2 W32 H4 ; limited MBL (INDX: at the purge line on the bed)
M84 E ; turn off E motor

G29 P1 ; invalidate MBL and probe print area
G29 P1 X148 Y0 W100 H20 C ; probe near purge area (INDX: 2 mm left, on the 248 mm bed)
G29 P3.2 ; MBL interpolation
G29 P3.13 ; MBL extrapolation outside probe area
G29 A ; activate MBL

; --- Preparation for Purge Line ---

M104 S{first_layer_temperature[initial_extruder]}
G0 X247 Y2 Z15 F4800 ; move away and ready for the purge (INDX: on the bed, clear of the docks)
M109 S{first_layer_temperature[initial_extruder]}

G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
M569 S0 E ; set spreadcycle mode for extruder

; --- Extrude Purge Line ---

G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
G1 E{(filament_type[initial_tool] == "FLEX" ? 4 : 2)} F2400 ; deretraction after the initial one
G0 E5 X235 Z0.2 F500 ; purge
G0 X225 E4 F500 ; purge
G0 X215 E4 F650 ; purge
G0 X205 E4 F800 ; purge
G0 X202 Z0.05 F8000 ; wipe, close to bed
G0 X199 Z0.2 F8000 ; wipe, quickly away from bed

G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
M221 S100 ; set flow to 100%
prusa_core_one_indx.end:
{if layer_z < max_print_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+1, max_print_height)} F720 ; move print head up{endif}
G1 E-1 F2400 ; additional retraction
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M141 S0 ; disable chamber control
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X242 Y200 F10200 ; park (INDX: at the back of the bed, clear of the docks)
G4 ; wait
M572 S0 ; reset PA
M84 X Y E ; disable motors
; max_layer_z = [max_layer_z]
prusa_core_one_indx.changeFilament:
; Tool change: the firmware parks the tool in the head in its dock and picks up the next one (written for SlicerX, estimated)
T[next_extruder]
M109 T[next_extruder] S{if layer_num < 1}{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[next_extruder]}{else}{nozzle_temperature[next_extruder]}{endif} ; wait for the new tool's temperature
